observations: Two photos show the same piece of industrial equipment from slightly different angles, on a tiled floor under a shed roof.

Equipment consists of a tall control cabinet with analog gauges, a small digital display, and switches, mounted above a set of vertical rams/molds with coil springs and cavities (appears to be a bottle/preform blow-molding or stretch-blow machine).
A second cabinet unit sits beside it on castors, with a panel of toggle switches, dials, and indicator lights.
Visible wear: rust spots, grime, and worn paint on the cabinet doors; exposed wiring and hoses near the mold area.
No brand name, model number, or serial plate is legible in either photo.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI - SEGUN ODESINA' overlays both images; this is a listing watermark, not equipment data.
No power cord connection, running state, or output (bottles/preforms) is shown in either photo.
Background shows an open-air or semi-outdoor workshop setting, not a clean controlled production floor.
